Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a large right pleural effusion with compressive atelectasis of the right lower lobe and an anomalous vein draining into the inferior vena cava/right atrium (scimitar sign), which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (a congenital vascular anomaly). Although the question mentions a chest X-ray, the provided figures are CT scans that confirm this specific diagnosis over general causes like heart failure or pneumonia.
